data.long_meaning: Ferzand is a Persian name that means 'high-born' or 'noble'. It is a title of respect and admiration, often given to those of noble lineage or character. The name Ferzand carries the meaning “High-born, noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ferzand usually hope their child will grow to embody high-born, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
